network_status.summary_it: Il rapporto del Servizio Idrologico elenca le sezioni monitorate durante l'evento del 23-24 ottobre, ma non include una misura sul Diaterna compatibile con il ponte di Firenzuola. Le stazioni di altri bacini toscani non vengono usate come sostituti.
network_status.summary_en: The Hydrological Service report lists the sections monitored during the 23-24 October event but includes no Diaterna measurement compatible with the Firenzuola bridge. Stations in other Tuscan catchments are not used as substitutes.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
